question: The Zone of Peace proposal for Nepal was put forward by which King, and in which year?
question_ne: नेपालका लागि शान्ति क्षेत्र प्रस्ताव कुन राजाले र कुन वर्ष अघि सारे?
explanation: King Birendra proposed Nepal as a Zone of Peace in 1975; it was endorsed by more than 100 countries.
explanation_ne: राजा वीरेन्द्रले सन् १९७५ मा नेपाललाई शान्ति क्षेत्र बनाउने प्रस्ताव गरे; १०० भन्दा बढी देशले समर्थन गरे।
source: Nepal Foreign Service syllabus: foreign policy, diplomacy & IR

question: In which year was Nepal's Ministry of Foreign Affairs established?
question_ne: नेपालको परराष्ट्र मन्त्रालय कुन वर्ष स्थापना भयो?
explanation: The Ministry of Foreign Affairs was established in 1951, after the democratic revolution ended Rana isolationism.
explanation_ne: परराष्ट्र मन्त्रालय सन् १९५१ मा स्थापना भयो, जब प्रजातान्त्रिक क्रान्तिले राणा एकान्तवाद अन्त्य गर्‍यो।
source: Nepal Foreign Service syllabus: foreign policy, diplomacy & IR

question: Nepal has established diplomatic relations with how many countries?
question_ne: नेपालले कति देशसँग कूटनीतिक सम्बन्ध स्थापना गरेको छ?
explanation: Nepal has diplomatic relations with more than 180 countries around the world.
explanation_ne: नेपालले विश्वभर १८० भन्दा बढी देशसँग कूटनीतिक सम्बन्ध स्थापना गरेको छ।
source: Nepal Foreign Service syllabus: foreign policy, diplomacy & IR

question: Nepal and China established diplomatic relations on:
question_ne: नेपाल र चीनले कूटनीतिक सम्बन्ध कहिले स्थापना गरे?
explanation: Nepal and China established diplomatic relations on 1 August 1955.
explanation_ne: नेपाल र चीनले १ अगस्ट १९५५ मा कूटनीतिक सम्बन्ध स्थापना गरे।
source: Nepal Foreign Service syllabus: foreign policy, diplomacy & IR

question: Nepal and Japan established diplomatic relations in:
question_ne: नेपाल र जापानले कूटनीतिक सम्बन्ध कुन वर्ष स्थापना गरे?
explanation: Nepal and Japan established diplomatic relations on 1 September 1956.
explanation_ne: नेपाल र जापानले १ सेप्टेम्बर १९५६ मा कूटनीतिक सम्बन्ध स्थापना गरे।
source: Nepal Foreign Service syllabus: foreign policy, diplomacy & IR

question: Nepal's first contribution to UN peacekeeping was in which year and mission?
question_ne: संयुक्त राष्ट्रसंघ शान्ति स्थापनामा नेपालको पहिलो योगदान कुन वर्ष र कुन मिसनमा थियो?
explanation: Nepal first sent peacekeepers in 1958 to UNOGIL (Lebanon) and is now among the largest troop contributors.
explanation_ne: नेपालले पहिलो पटक सन् १९५८ मा UNOGIL (लेबनान) मा शान्ति सैनिक पठायो र अहिले सबैभन्दा ठूला सैन्य योगदानकर्ता मध्ये एक हो।
source: Nepal Foreign Service syllabus: foreign policy, diplomacy & IR

question: Nepal is known in UN peacekeeping as:
question_ne: संयुक्त राष्ट्रसंघ शान्ति स्थापनामा नेपाल के रूपमा परिचित छ?
options: One of the largest troop-contributing countries
options_ne: सबैभन्दा ठूला सैन्य योगदानकर्ता देशमध्ये एक
explanation: Nepal is consistently among the top troop-contributing countries to UN peacekeeping missions.
explanation_ne: नेपाल संयुक्त राष्ट्रसंघ शान्ति मिसनमा निरन्तर शीर्ष सैन्य योगदानकर्ता देशमध्ये एक हो।
source: Nepal Foreign Service syllabus: foreign policy, diplomacy & IR

question: Nepal has never been a member of which UN organ?
question_ne: नेपाल संयुक्त राष्ट्रसंघको कुन अंगको सदस्य कहिल्यै भएको छैन?
explanation: Nepal has served on ECOSOC and the Human Rights Council but has never been a member of the Security Council.
explanation_ne: नेपाल ECOSOC र मानव अधिकार परिषद्मा सेवा गरेको छ तर सुरक्षा परिषद्को सदस्य कहिल्यै भएको छैन।
source: Nepal Foreign Service syllabus: foreign policy, diplomacy & IR

question: Which article of the Constitution of Nepal directs the State to pursue an independent foreign policy?
question_ne: नेपालको संविधानको कुन धाराले राज्यलाई स्वतन्त्र परराष्ट्र नीति अनुसरण गर्न निर्देश गर्छ?
explanation: Article 51 (state policies) directs Nepal to follow an independent foreign policy based on Panchasheel and non-alignment.
explanation_ne: धारा ५१ (राज्यका नीतिहरू) ले नेपाललाई पञ्चशील र असंलग्नतामा आधारित स्वतन्त्र परराष्ट्र नीति पालना गर्न निर्देश गर्छ।
source: Nepal Foreign Service syllabus: foreign policy, diplomacy & IR

question: India is Nepal's largest trading partner, accounting for about what share of Nepal's total trade?
question_ne: भारत नेपालको सबैभन्दा ठूलो व्यापार साझेदार हो, जसले नेपालको कुल व्यापारको लगभग कति हिस्सा ओगट्छ?
explanation: India accounts for roughly two-thirds of Nepal's total foreign trade.
explanation_ne: भारतले नेपालको कुल वैदेशिक व्यापारको लगभग दुई तिहाइ हिस्सा ओगट्छ।
source: Nepal Foreign Service syllabus: foreign policy, diplomacy & IR

question: Which of the following best describes Nepal's position between India and China?
question_ne: भारत र चीनबीच नेपालको स्थिति कुनले सबैभन्दा राम्रो वर्णन गर्छ?
options: A landlocked buffer state balancing both neighbours
A member of a military alliance
options_ne: दुवै छिमेकीलाई सन्तुलन गर्ने भूमिबन्द मध्यवर्ती राज्य
explanation: As a landlocked country between two large neighbours, Nepal balances relations with both India and China.
explanation_ne: दुई ठूला छिमेकीबीचको भूमिबन्द देशका रूपमा नेपालले भारत र चीन दुवैसँग सम्बन्ध सन्तुलन गर्छ।
source: Nepal Foreign Service syllabus: foreign policy, diplomacy & IR

question: The Panchasheel principles were first formally stated in which agreement?
question_ne: पञ्चशील सिद्धान्त पहिलो पटक औपचारिक रूपमा कुन सम्झौतामा उल्लेख गरियो?
explanation: Panchasheel (Five Principles of Peaceful Coexistence) was first stated in the 1954 India-China agreement on Tibet.
explanation_ne: पञ्चशील (शान्तिपूर्ण सहअस्तित्वका पाँच सिद्धान्त) पहिलो पटक सन् १९५४ को तिब्बतबारे भारत-चीन सम्झौतामा उल्लेख गरियो।
source: Nepal Foreign Service syllabus: foreign policy, diplomacy & IR

question: Nepal joined the Non-Aligned Movement at which summit?
question_ne: नेपाल असंलग्न आन्दोलनमा कुन शिखर सम्मेलनमा सामेल भयो?
explanation: Nepal was a founding participant of the Non-Aligned Movement at the Belgrade Summit in 1961.
explanation_ne: नेपाल सन् १९६१ को बेलग्रेड शिखर सम्मेलनमा असंलग्न आन्दोलनको संस्थापक सहभागी थियो।
source: Nepal Foreign Service syllabus: foreign policy, diplomacy & IR

question: How many non-permanent members are there in the UN Security Council?
question_ne: संयुक्त राष्ट्रसंघ सुरक्षा परिषद्मा कति अस्थायी सदस्य छन्?
explanation: The Security Council has 15 members: 5 permanent members with veto power and 10 non-permanent members elected for two-year terms.
explanation_ne: सुरक्षा परिषद्मा १५ सदस्य छन्: भिटो शक्ति भएका ५ स्थायी सदस्य र दुई वर्षे कार्यकालका लागि निर्वाचित १० अस्थायी सदस्य।
source: Nepal Foreign Service syllabus: foreign policy, diplomacy & IR

question: How many members are there in the UN Economic and Social Council (ECOSOC)?
question_ne: संयुक्त राष्ट्रसंघ आर्थिक तथा सामाजिक परिषद् (ECOSOC) मा कति सदस्य छन्?
explanation: ECOSOC has 54 members elected by the General Assembly for three-year terms.
explanation_ne: ECOSOC मा महासभाबाट तीन वर्षका लागि निर्वाचित ५४ सदस्य छन्।
source: Nepal Foreign Service syllabus: foreign policy, diplomacy & IR

question: How many judges are there in the International Court of Justice (ICJ)?
question_ne: अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय न्याय अदालत (ICJ) मा कति न्यायाधीश छन्?
explanation: The ICJ has 15 judges elected for nine-year terms by the General Assembly and the Security Council.
explanation_ne: ICJ मा महासभा र सुरक्षा परिषद्बाट नौ वर्षका लागि निर्वाचित १५ न्यायाधीश छन्।
source: Nepal Foreign Service syllabus: foreign policy, diplomacy & IR

question: The United Nations Charter was signed in which city and year?
question_ne: संयुक्त राष्ट्रसंघ बडापत्र कुन सहर र वर्षमा हस्ताक्षर भयो?
explanation: The UN Charter was signed in San Francisco on 26 June 1945 and came into force on 24 October 1945.
explanation_ne: संयुक्त राष्ट्रसंघ बडापत्र २६ जुन १९४५ मा सान फ्रान्सिस्कोमा हस्ताक्षर भयो र २४ अक्टोबर १९४५ मा लागू भयो।
source: Nepal Foreign Service syllabus: foreign policy, diplomacy & IR

question: How many member countries does the World Trade Organization (WTO) have as of 2024?
question_ne: सन् २०२४ सम्म विश्व व्यापार संगठन (WTO) मा कति सदस्य राष्ट्र छन्?
explanation: The WTO had 166 members as of 2024, after Comoros and Timor-Leste joined in August 2024.
explanation_ne: WTO मा सन् २०२४ सम्म १६६ सदस्य थिए, अगस्ट २०२४ मा कोमोरोस र टिमोर-लेस्टे सामेल भएपछि।
source: Nepal Foreign Service syllabus: foreign policy, diplomacy & IR

question: The World Bank was established at which conference in 1944?
question_ne: विश्व बैंक सन् १९४४ मा कुन सम्मेलनमा स्थापना भयो?
explanation: The World Bank (IBRD) was created at the Bretton Woods Conference in 1944, along with the International Monetary Fund.
explanation_ne: विश्व बैंक (IBRD) सन् १९४४ मा ब्रेटन वुड्स सम्मेलनमा अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय मुद्रा कोषसँगै सिर्जना भयो।
source: Nepal Foreign Service syllabus: foreign policy, diplomacy & IR

question: Nepal became a member of the Asian Development Bank (ADB) in which year?
question_ne: नेपाल एसियाली विकास बैंक (ADB) को सदस्य कुन वर्ष भयो?
explanation: Nepal was a founding member of the Asian Development Bank, joining it in 1966, the year the bank was established.
explanation_ne: नेपाल एसियाली विकास बैंकको संस्थापक सदस्य थियो, बैंक स्थापना भएको वर्ष सन् १९६६ मा सामेल भयो।
source: Nepal Foreign Service syllabus: foreign policy, diplomacy & IR

question: The Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank (AIIB) began operations in which year?
question_ne: एसियाली पूर्वाधार लगानी बैंक (AIIB) ले सञ्चालन कुन वर्ष सुरु गर्‍यो?
explanation: The AIIB, headquartered in Beijing, began operations in January 2016 with 57 founding members.
explanation_ne: बेइजिङमा मुख्यालय रहेको AIIB ले जनवरी २०१६ मा ५७ संस्थापक सदस्यसहित सञ्चालन सुरु गर्‍यो।
source: Nepal Foreign Service syllabus: foreign policy, diplomacy & IR

question: ASEAN was founded in 1967 by how many countries?
question_ne: आसियान सन् १९६७ मा कति देशले स्थापना गरे?
explanation: ASEAN was founded in 1967 by Indonesia, Malaysia, the Philippines, Singapore and Thailand.
explanation_ne: आसियान सन् १९६७ मा इन्डोनेसिया, मलेसिया, फिलिपिन्स, सिंगापुर र थाइल्यान्डले स्थापना गरे।
source: Nepal Foreign Service syllabus: foreign policy, diplomacy & IR

question: The South Asian Free Trade Area (SAFTA) agreement came into force in:
question_ne: दक्षिण एसियाली स्वतन्त्र व्यापार क्षेत्र (SAFTA) सम्झौता कहिले लागू भयो?
explanation: SAFTA was signed in 2004 and came into force on 1 January 2006.
explanation_ne: SAFTA सन् २००४ मा हस्ताक्षर भयो र १ जनवरी २००६ मा लागू भयो।
source: Nepal Foreign Service syllabus: foreign policy, diplomacy & IR

question: Which is the smallest member of SAARC by area?
question_ne: क्षेत्रफलको हिसाबले सार्कको सबैभन्दा सानो सदस्य कुन हो?
explanation: Maldives is the smallest SAARC member by area (about 300 sq km) and also the smallest by population.
explanation_ne: माल्दिभ्स क्षेत्रफल (लगभग ३०० वर्ग किमी) र जनसंख्या दुवै हिसाबले सार्कको सबैभन्दा सानो सदस्य हो।
source: Nepal Foreign Service syllabus: foreign policy, diplomacy & IR

question: The first Secretary-General of SAARC was from which country?
question_ne: सार्कका पहिलो महासचिव कुन देशका थिए?
explanation: Abul Ahsan of Bangladesh was the first Secretary-General of SAARC (1987–1989).
explanation_ne: बंगलादेशका अबुल अहसान सार्कका पहिलो महासचिव थिए (१९८७–१९८९)।
source: Nepal Foreign Service syllabus: foreign policy, diplomacy & IR

question: The 4th BIMSTEC Summit was held in Kathmandu in which year?
question_ne: चौथो बिमस्टेक शिखर सम्मेलन काठमाडौंमा कुन वर्ष भयो?
explanation: The 4th BIMSTEC Summit was held in Kathmandu in August 2018.
explanation_ne: चौथो बिमस्टेक शिखर सम्मेलन अगस्ट २०१८ मा काठमाडौंमा भयो।
source: Nepal Foreign Service syllabus: foreign policy, diplomacy & IR

question: A chargé d'affaires is a diplomat who:
question_ne: चार्जे द'अफेयर्स भनेको कस्तो कूटनीतिज्ञ हो?
options: Heads a diplomatic mission in the absence of the ambassador
Is the head of a consulate
options_ne: राजदूतको अनुपस्थितिमा कूटनीतिक मिसनको नेतृत्व गर्छ
explanation: A chargé d'affaires leads the mission when the ambassador is absent or the post is vacant.
explanation_ne: चार्जे द'अफेयर्सले राजदूत अनुपस्थित हुँदा वा पद खाली हुँदा मिसनको नेतृत्व गर्छ।
source: Nepal Foreign Service syllabus: foreign policy, diplomacy & IR

question: A diplomatic pouch (bag) is:
question_ne: कूटनीतिक झोला (पाउच) भनेको के हो?
options: Inviolable and not subject to search by the host state
options_ne: अलंघनीय र मेजबान राज्यले जाँच गर्न नसक्ने
explanation: Under the Vienna Convention, the diplomatic bag is inviolable and must not be opened or detained.
explanation_ne: भियना महासन्धिअनुसार कूटनीतिक झोला अलंघनीय हुन्छ र त्यसलाई खोल्न वा रोक्न हुँदैन।
source: Nepal Foreign Service syllabus: foreign policy, diplomacy & IR

question: A démarche in diplomacy is:
question_ne: कूटनीतिमा डेमार्श भनेको के हो?
options: A formal diplomatic representation or protest to another government
options_ne: अर्को सरकारसमक्ष औपचारिक कूटनीतिक प्रतिनिधित्व वा विरोध
explanation: A démarche is a formal diplomatic approach, often to protest or to seek action on an issue.
explanation_ne: डेमार्श भनेको औपचारिक कूटनीतिक पहल हो, प्रायः विरोध गर्न वा विषयमा कारबाही माग्न।
source: Nepal Foreign Service syllabus: foreign policy, diplomacy & IR

question: A note verbale is:
question_ne: नोट भर्बेल भनेको के हो?
options: A formal unsigned diplomatic note between governments
options_ne: सरकारबीचको औपचारिक हस्ताक्षर नभएको कूटनीतिक नोट
explanation: A note verbale is a formal diplomatic communication, written in the third person and unsigned.
explanation_ne: नोट भर्बेल भनेको औपचारिक कूटनीतिक सञ्चार हो, जुन तेस्रो पुरुषमा लेखिन्छ र हस्ताक्षर हुँदैन।
source: Nepal Foreign Service syllabus: foreign policy, diplomacy & IR

question: An aide-mémoire in diplomacy is:
question_ne: कूटनीतिमा एड-मेम्वार भनेको के हो?
options: A written summary handed over to aid the memory of a discussion
options_ne: छलफल सम्झन मद्दत गर्न दिइने लिखित सारांश
explanation: An aide-mémoire is a written summary of points discussed, left with the other party.
explanation_ne: एड-मेम्वार भनेको छलफल गरिएका बुँदाको लिखित सारांश हो, जुन अर्को पक्षलाई छोडिन्छ।
source: Nepal Foreign Service syllabus: foreign policy, diplomacy & IR

question: Exequatur in consular relations is:
question_ne: कन्सुलर सम्बन्धमा एक्जेक्वाटर भनेको के हो?
options: The host state's authorization for a consul to act
options_ne: कन्सुलले काम गर्न मेजबान राज्यको अधिकार
explanation: An exequatur is the host government's permission allowing a consul to perform consular functions.
explanation_ne: एक्जेक्वाटर भनेको कन्सुललाई कन्सुलर कार्य गर्न दिने मेजबान सरकारको अनुमति हो।
source: Nepal Foreign Service syllabus: foreign policy, diplomacy & IR

question: Diplomatic asylum is asylum granted in:
question_ne: कूटनीतिक शरण भनेको कहाँ दिइने शरण हो?
options: A diplomatic mission (embassy) of a foreign state
explanation: Diplomatic asylum is protection given to a person inside a foreign embassy.
explanation_ne: कूटनीतिक शरण भनेको विदेशी दूतावासभित्र व्यक्तिलाई दिइने सुरक्षा हो।
source: Nepal Foreign Service syllabus: foreign policy, diplomacy & IR

question: Extradition is the process of:
question_ne: सुपुर्दगी (एक्स्ट्राडिसन) भनेको के गर्ने प्रक्रिया हो?
options: Handing over an accused person to another state for trial
options_ne: अभियुक्तलाई मुद्दाका लागि अर्को राज्यलाई हस्तान्तरण गर्नु
explanation: Extradition is the formal surrender of an accused or convicted person to the state where the crime was committed.
explanation_ne: सुपुर्दगी भनेको अभियुक्त वा दोषी व्यक्तिलाई अपराध भएको राज्यलाई औपचारिक रूपमा सुम्पनु हो।
source: Nepal Foreign Service syllabus: foreign policy, diplomacy & IR

question: The Dean of the Diplomatic Corps in a capital is usually:
question_ne: राजधानीमा कूटनीतिक समुदायका डीन सामान्यतया को हुन्छन्?
options: The longest-serving ambassador (often the Papal Nuncio)
options_ne: सबैभन्दा लामो समयदेखि कार्यरत राजदूत (प्रायः पोपका नुन्सियो)
explanation: The Dean is the longest-serving head of mission; by tradition it is often the Papal Nuncio.
explanation_ne: डीन भनेको सबैभन्दा लामो समयदेखि कार्यरत मिसन प्रमुख हुन्; परम्पराअनुसार प्रायः पोपका नुन्सियो हुन्छन्।
source: Nepal Foreign Service syllabus: foreign policy, diplomacy & IR

question: When a state breaks diplomatic relations with another state, it usually:
question_ne: जब एउटा राज्यले अर्को राज्यसँग कूटनीतिक सम्बन्ध तोड्छ, यसले सामान्यतया के गर्छ?
options: Closes its borders to trade only
Closes its embassy and withdraws its diplomats
options_ne: व्यापारका लागि मात्र सीमा बन्द गर्छ
आफ्नो दूतावास बन्द गर्छ र कूटनीतिज्ञ फिर्ता बोलाउँछ
explanation: Breaking relations means closing the embassy and withdrawing diplomats; a third state may protect interests.
explanation_ne: सम्बन्ध तोड्नुको अर्थ दूतावास बन्द गर्नु र कूटनीतिज्ञ फिर्ता बोलाउनु हो; तेस्रो राज्यले हित सुरक्षा गर्न सक्छ।
source: Nepal Foreign Service syllabus: foreign policy, diplomacy & IR

question: Diplomatic immunity generally does NOT cover:
question_ne: कूटनीतिक उन्मुक्तिले सामान्यतया के समेट्दैन?
options: Private commercial activity of the diplomat
explanation: Immunity does not extend to a diplomat's private commercial activities or private property disputes.
explanation_ne: उन्मुक्ति कूटनीतिज्ञको निजी व्यापारिक गतिविधि वा निजी सम्पत्ति विवादमा विस्तार हुँदैन।
source: Nepal Foreign Service syllabus: foreign policy, diplomacy & IR

question: The recall of an ambassador by their own government means:
question_ne: राजदूतलाई आफ्नै सरकारले फिर्ता बोलाउनुको अर्थ के हो?
options: The ambassador is ordered to return home, often as a protest
options_ne: राजदूतलाई घर फर्कन आदेश दिइन्छ, प्रायः विरोधस्वरूप
explanation: Recalling an ambassador is a strong diplomatic signal of displeasure with the host state.
explanation_ne: राजदूत फिर्ता बोलाउनु मेजबान राज्यप्रति असन्तुष्टिको बलियो कूटनीतिक संकेत हो।
source: Nepal Foreign Service syllabus: foreign policy, diplomacy & IR

question: An attaché in an embassy is:
question_ne: दूतावासमा सहचारी (अट्याशे) भनेको को हो?
options: A specialist officer (e.g. military, cultural, commercial)
explanation: An attaché is a specialist member of a diplomatic mission, such as a military or commercial attaché.
explanation_ne: सहचारी कूटनीतिक मिसनका विशेषज्ञ सदस्य हुन्, जस्तै सैन्य वा व्यापारिक सहचारी।
source: Nepal Foreign Service syllabus: foreign policy, diplomacy & IR

question: A consul general heads a:
question_ne: महावाणिज्यदूत (कन्सुल जनरल) ले के को नेतृत्व गर्छ?
explanation: A consul general heads a consulate general, which handles consular work such as visas and citizen services.
explanation_ne: महावाणिज्यदूतले महावाणिज्य दूतावासको नेतृत्व गर्छ, जसले भिसा र नागरिक सेवा जस्ता कन्सुलर कार्य हेर्छ।
source: Nepal Foreign Service syllabus: foreign policy, diplomacy & IR

question: A letter of credence is presented by a new ambassador to:
question_ne: नयाँ राजदूतले परिचयपत्र (लेटर अफ क्रिडेन्स) कससमक्ष प्रस्तुत गर्छ?
options: The head of state of the host country
explanation: An ambassador presents credentials to the host head of state to be formally accredited.
explanation_ne: राजदूतले औपचारिक रूपमा मान्यता पाउन मेजबान राष्ट्र प्रमुखसमक्ष परिचयपत्र प्रस्तुत गर्छ।
source: Nepal Foreign Service syllabus: foreign policy, diplomacy & IR

question: Realism in international relations, associated with Hans Morgenthau, holds that states act mainly to:
question_ne: ह्यान्स मोर्गेन्थाउसँग सम्बन्धित अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय सम्बन्धमा यथार्थवादले राज्य मुख्यतया के गर्न कार्य गर्छन् भनेर मान्छ?
options_ne: शक्ति अधिकतम गरी अस्तित्व सुनिश्चित गर्नु
explanation: Realism sees states as power-seeking actors in an anarchic system, acting to ensure their survival.
explanation_ne: यथार्थवादले राज्यलाई अराजक प्रणालीमा शक्ति खोज्ने कर्ताका रूपमा हेर्छ, जसले आफ्नो अस्तित्व सुनिश्चित गर्न कार्य गर्छ।
source: Nepal Foreign Service syllabus: foreign policy, diplomacy & IR

question: The balance of power in international relations means:
question_ne: अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय सम्बन्धमा शक्ति सन्तुलनको अर्थ के हो?
options: No single state becomes strong enough to dominate others
options_ne: कुनै एक राज्य अरूलाई हावी गर्न पर्याप्त बलियो हुँदैन
explanation: Balance of power is a distribution of power that prevents any one state from dominating the system.
explanation_ne: शक्ति सन्तुलन भनेको शक्तिको वितरण हो जसले कुनै एक राज्यलाई प्रणालीमा हावी हुनबाट रोक्छ।
source: Nepal Foreign Service syllabus: foreign policy, diplomacy & IR

question: Collective security means that:
question_ne: सामूहिक सुरक्षा को अर्थ के हो?
options: An attack on one state is treated as an attack on all
options_ne: एउटा राज्यमाथिको आक्रमण सबैमाथिको आक्रमण मानिन्छ
प्रत्येक राज्यले एक्लै आफ्नो रक्षा गर्छ
explanation: Collective security (e.g. the UN Charter) treats aggression against one member as aggression against all.
explanation_ne: सामूहिक सुरक्षा (जस्तै संयुक्त राष्ट्रसंघ बडापत्र) ले एक सदस्यविरुद्ध आक्रमणलाई सबैविरुद्ध आक्रमण मान्छ।
source: Nepal Foreign Service syllabus: foreign policy, diplomacy & IR

question: Détente in international relations refers to:
question_ne: अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय सम्बन्धमा डेटान्टको अर्थ के हो?
options: Easing of tension between rival states
explanation: Détente is the easing of strained relations, notably between the USA and USSR in the 1970s.
explanation_ne: डेटान्ट भनेको तनावपूर्ण सम्बन्ध सहज हुनु हो, विशेष गरी १९७० को दशकमा अमेरिका र सोभियत संघबीच।
source: Nepal Foreign Service syllabus: foreign policy, diplomacy & IR

question: Shuttle diplomacy is associated with which US Secretary of State?
question_ne: शटल कूटनीति कुन अमेरिकी विदेशमन्त्रीसँग सम्बन्धित छ?
explanation: Henry Kissinger practised shuttle diplomacy, travelling between parties to negotiate Middle East agreements in the 1970s.
explanation_ne: हेनरी किसिन्जरले १९७० को दशकमा मध्यपूर्व सम्झौता वार्ता गर्न पक्षबीच यात्रा गरी शटल कूटनीति अभ्यास गरे।
source: Nepal Foreign Service syllabus: foreign policy, diplomacy & IR

question: Track-two diplomacy involves:
question_ne: ट्र्याक-टू कूटनीतिमा के संलग्न हुन्छ?
options: Official talks between heads of state
explanation: Track-two diplomacy is informal dialogue by academics, former officials and civil society to support official talks.
explanation_ne: ट्र्याक-टू कूटनीति भनेको आधिकारिक वार्तालाई समर्थन गर्न शिक्षाविद्, पूर्व अधिकारी र नागरिक समाजद्वारा अनौपचारिक संवाद हो।
source: Nepal Foreign Service syllabus: foreign policy, diplomacy & IR

question: Ping-pong diplomacy of 1971 helped improve relations between:
question_ne: सन् १९७१ को पिङ-पङ कूटनीतिले कुनबीच सम्बन्ध सुधार गर्न मद्दत गर्‍यो?
explanation: Table tennis exchanges in 1971 opened the way for US-China rapprochement and Nixon's 1972 visit.
explanation_ne: सन् १९७१ मा टेबल टेनिस आदानप्रदानले अमेरिका-चीन मेलमिलाप र निक्सनको १९७२ भ्रमणको बाटो खोल्यो।
source: Nepal Foreign Service syllabus: foreign policy, diplomacy & IR

question: Dollar diplomacy is a foreign policy based on:
question_ne: डलर कूटनीति भनेको कुनमा आधारित परराष्ट्र नीति हो?
options: Using economic investment and loans to extend influence
options_ne: प्रभाव विस्तार गर्न आर्थिक लगानी र ऋण प्रयोग गर्नु
explanation: Dollar diplomacy (associated with US President Taft) used economic power to advance foreign policy goals.
explanation_ne: डलर कूटनीति (अमेरिकी राष्ट्रपति टाफ्टसँग सम्बन्धित) ले परराष्ट्र नीति लक्ष्य अगाडि बढाउन आर्थिक शक्ति प्रयोग गर्‍यो।
source: Nepal Foreign Service syllabus: foreign policy, diplomacy & IR

question: Appeasement in international relations is best illustrated by:
question_ne: अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय सम्बन्धमा तुष्टीकरण (एपिजमेन्ट) को सबैभन्दा राम्रो उदाहरण के हो?
explanation: The Munich Agreement (1938), letting Germany annex the Sudetenland, is the classic example of appeasement.
explanation_ne: म्युनिख सम्झौता (१९३८), जसले जर्मनीलाई सुडेटेनल्याण्ड गाभ्न दियो, तुष्टीकरणको उत्कृष्ट उदाहरण हो।
source: Nepal Foreign Service syllabus: foreign policy, diplomacy & IR

question: Hard power in international relations refers to:
question_ne: अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय सम्बन्धमा हार्ड पावर भनेको के हो?
explanation: Hard power uses military force and economic sanctions; soft power works through attraction and persuasion.
explanation_ne: हार्ड पावरले सैन्य बल र आर्थिक प्रतिबन्ध प्रयोग गर्छ; सफ्ट पावर आकर्षण र अनुनयबाट काम गर्छ।
source: Nepal Foreign Service syllabus: foreign policy, diplomacy & IR

question: The Treaty of Sugauli (1816) ended which war?
question_ne: सुगौली सन्धि (१८१६) ले कुन युद्ध अन्त्य गर्‍यो?
explanation: The Sugauli Treaty ended the Anglo-Nepalese War; Nepal lost large territories including Sikkim, Kumaon and Garhwal.
explanation_ne: सुगौली सन्धिले एंग्लो-नेपाल युद्ध अन्त्य गर्‍यो; नेपालले सिक्किम, कुमाउँ र गढवालसहित ठूलो भूभाग गुमायो।
source: Nepal Foreign Service syllabus: foreign policy, diplomacy & IR

question: The Treaty of Sugauli (1816) was signed between Nepal and which other party?
question_ne: सुगौली सन्धि (सन् १८१६) नेपाल र कुन अर्को पक्षबीच हस्ताक्षर भयो?
explanation: The Treaty of Sugauli was signed in 1816 between Nepal and the British East India Company, ending the Anglo-Nepalese War.
explanation_ne: सुगौली सन्धि सन् १८१६ मा नेपाल र ब्रिटिस इस्ट इन्डिया कम्पनीबीच हस्ताक्षर भयो, जसले एंग्लो-नेपाल युद्ध अन्त्य गर्‍यो।
source: Nepal Foreign Service syllabus: foreign policy, diplomacy & IR

question: Which agreement of 1961 settled the boundary between Nepal and China?
question_ne: सन् १९६१ को कुन सम्झौताले नेपाल र चीनबीचको सीमा निर्धारण गर्‍यो?
explanation: The Nepal-China Boundary Agreement, signed on 5 October 1961, formally delimited the border between Nepal and China.
explanation_ne: नेपाल-चीन सीमा सम्झौता, ५ अक्टोबर १९६१ मा हस्ताक्षर भयो, जसले नेपाल र चीनबीचको सीमा औपचारिक रूपमा निर्धारण गर्‍यो।
source: Nepal Foreign Service syllabus: foreign policy, diplomacy & IR

question: The Koshi Agreement of 1954 between Nepal and India was signed for the construction of:
question_ne: नेपाल र भारतबीच सन् १९५४ को कोशी सम्झौता के निर्माण गर्न हस्ताक्षर भयो?
explanation: The Koshi Agreement (1954) provided for the construction of the Koshi Barrage on the Sapta Koshi river for flood control and irrigation.
explanation_ne: कोशी सम्झौता (सन् १९५४) ले बाढी नियन्त्रण र सिँचाइका लागि सप्तकोशी नदीमा कोशी ब्यारेज निर्माण गर्ने व्यवस्था गर्‍यो।
source: Nepal Foreign Service syllabus: foreign policy, diplomacy & IR

question: The Gandak Agreement of 1959 between Nepal and India was signed for the construction of:
question_ne: नेपाल र भारतबीच सन् १९५९ को गण्डक सम्झौता के निर्माण गर्न हस्ताक्षर भयो?
explanation: The Gandak Agreement (1959) provided for the construction of the Gandak Barrage on the Narayani (Gandak) river for irrigation and power.
explanation_ne: गण्डक सम्झौता (सन् १९५९) ले सिँचाइ र विद्युतका लागि नारायणी (गण्डक) नदीमा गण्डक ब्यारेज निर्माण गर्ने व्यवस्था गर्‍यो।
source: Nepal Foreign Service syllabus: foreign policy, diplomacy & IR

question: The Nepal-Britain Treaty of 1923 is significant because it:
question_ne: सन् १९२३ को नेपाल-ब्रिटेन सन्धि महत्त्वपूर्ण छ किनभने यसले:
options: Recognized Nepal as an independent sovereign state
options_ne: नेपाललाई स्वतन्त्र सार्वभौम राज्यका रूपमा मान्यता दियो
explanation: The 1923 Treaty of Friendship recognized Nepal's independence and sovereignty.
explanation_ne: सन् १९२३ को मैत्री सन्धिले नेपालको स्वतन्त्रता र सार्वभौमसत्ता मान्यता दियो।
source: Nepal Foreign Service syllabus: foreign policy, diplomacy & IR

question: Nepal signed a transit transport agreement with China in which year, giving Nepal a third-country transit route?
question_ne: नेपालले चीनसँग पारवहन यातायात सम्झौता कुन वर्ष हस्ताक्षर गर्‍यो, जसले नेपाललाई तेस्रो देश पारवहन मार्ग दियो?
explanation: Nepal and China signed the transit transport agreement in March 2016, letting Nepal use Chinese ports for third-country trade.
explanation_ne: नेपाल र चीनले मार्च २०१६ मा पारवहन यातायात सम्झौता हस्ताक्षर गरे, जसले नेपाललाई तेस्रो देश व्यापारका लागि चिनियाँ बन्दरगाह प्रयोग गर्न दियो।
source: Nepal Foreign Service syllabus: foreign policy, diplomacy & IR

question: Nepal signed the Belt and Road Initiative (BRI) framework agreement with China in:
question_ne: नेपालले चीनसँग बेल्ट एन्ड रोड इनिसिएटिभ (BRI) ढाँचा सम्झौता कहिले हस्ताक्षर गर्‍यो?
explanation: Nepal signed the BRI framework agreement with China in May 2017.
explanation_ne: नेपालले मे २०१७ मा चीनसँग BRI ढाँचा सम्झौता हस्ताक्षर गर्‍यो।
source: Nepal Foreign Service syllabus: foreign policy, diplomacy & IR

question: The Millennium Challenge Corporation (MCC) compact with Nepal was ratified by Nepal's parliament in:
question_ne: नेपालसँग मिलेनियम च्यालेन्ज कर्पोरेसन (MCC) सम्झौता नेपालको संसदले कुन वर्ष अनुमोदन गर्‍यो?
explanation: The MCC compact, signed in 2017, was ratified by Nepal's parliament in February 2022.
explanation_ne: MCC सम्झौता, सन् २०१७ मा हस्ताक्षर भएको, फेब्रुअरी २०२२ मा नेपालको संसदले अनुमोदन गर्‍यो।
source: Nepal Foreign Service syllabus: foreign policy, diplomacy & IR

question: Nepal joined the World Trade Organization in 2004 as the first:
question_ne: नेपाल सन् २००४ मा विश्व व्यापार संगठनमा पहिलो केका रूपमा सामेल भयो?
options: Least Developed Country to join through negotiations
options_ne: वार्ताबाट सामेल हुने पहिलो अल्पविकसित देश
सामेल हुने पहिलो दक्षिण एसियाली देश
explanation: Nepal joined the WTO on 23 April 2004 as the first Least Developed Country to accede through the full negotiation process.
explanation_ne: नेपाल २३ अप्रिल २००४ मा पूर्ण वार्ता प्रक्रियाबाट सामेल हुने पहिलो अल्पविकसित देशका रूपमा WTO मा सामेल भयो।
source: Nepal Foreign Service syllabus: foreign policy, diplomacy & IR

question: Nepal signed a Treaty of Friendship and Commerce with the United States in:
question_ne: नेपालले संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिकासँग मैत्री तथा वाणिज्य सन्धि कुन वर्ष हस्ताक्षर गर्‍यो?
explanation: Nepal signed the Treaty of Friendship and Commerce with the USA on 25 April 1947, its first treaty with a major Western power.
explanation_ne: नेपालले २५ अप्रिल १९४७ मा अमेरिकासँग मैत्री तथा वाणिज्य सन्धि हस्ताक्षर गर्‍यो, जुन ठूलो पश्चिमी शक्तिसँगको पहिलो सन्धि थियो।
source: Nepal Foreign Service syllabus: foreign policy, diplomacy & IR

question: Nepal joined BIMSTEC as a member in:
question_ne: नेपाल बिमस्टेकको सदस्य कुन वर्ष बन्यो?

question: The theoretical peak download speed of 5G is up to about:
